name: Meeting Statistics

native.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mtg_bookings WHERE tenant_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM mtg_rooms) AND start_time >= date_trunc('week', NOW()) AND status = 'CONFIRMED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.name, COUNT(b.id) as booking_count FROM mtg_bookings b JOIN mtg_rooms r ON r.id = b.room_id WHERE b.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' AND b.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY booking_count DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM mtg_action_items WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY status
